{"subject":"223 Show HN domains on Resend","body":"Hi there,

I saw the October Hacker News post that counted 223 of 8,062 Show HN domains sending with Resend. That's a striking footprint among people shipping new products. It lines up with Resend appearing alongside Postmark, Amazon SES and SendGrid in an October comparison of transactional email services.

I'd love to hear what you're seeing from that early-builder crowd and where you're taking it next. Would a 20-minute call in the next couple of weeks work?

Daniel"}
